graphs.name: arch-review
graphs.description: Architecture review: scope detect -> architecture review report

graphs.name: grill-with-docs
graphs.description: Raw idea entry: scope → grilling interview with inline domain-modeling side effects → decision gate. Two-track shared idea-sharpening entry.

graphs.name: skill-author
graphs.description: Skill authoring: create or edit — scope → write → review → approve → output

graphs.name: skill-delete
graphs.description: Skill deletion: select → impact analysis → confirm → execute → review → approve

graphs.name: graph-generate
graphs.description: Graph generation: interview → design → write → review → approve → examples

graphs.name: doc-update
graphs.description: Document update: interview → analyze → confirm → write → review → approve

graphs.name: plan-generate
graphs.description: Generic plan generation: scope interview -> to-spec PRD -> optional to-tickets split. Reusable via flow type by orchestration graphs.

graphs.name: openspec-create
graphs.description: OpenSpec spec creation: scope interview with input source detection (wayfinder-map/arch-review/grill-consensus/direct) + inline ADR judgment -> gate -> openspec propose CLI delegation

graphs.name: arch-review-loop
graphs.description: Closed-loop architecture review: entry (existing report or fresh review + auto-approve mode) → arch-review re-review (round worker) → approve Top Rec → openspec-pipeline → round-end approval (Loop again default, Complete = user ends) → loop until the user approves ending

graphs.name: implement
graphs.description: Generic implementation: input-source detection (openspec-change/tickets/prd) -> tdd implementation -> dual-axis review -> bounded gate -> conditional OpenSpec archive

graphs.name: skill-change-workflow
graphs.description: Orchestrated skill change: plan → flow phases (author + delete + doc) → cross review → approval

graphs.name: openspec-apply
graphs.description: OpenSpec apply pipeline: apply change → dual review → bounded auto-rework gate → archive

graphs.name: openspec-engineer
graphs.description: OpenSpec detailed implementation: spec synthesis → tickets → tdd implementation → dual review → bounded gate → approval → reverse-validated archive

graphs.name: openspec-pipeline
graphs.description: OpenSpec full-lifecycle pipeline: raw idea entry (grill-with-docs) → spec creation (openspec-create) → human gate → branch (openspec-apply direct / openspec-engineer detailed) → archive
